stage.quote: Tensorlake investors: Plug and Play Tech Center — Seed; Hawk Hill Ventures — Seed; Artisanal Ventures — Seed; Materialized View Capital — Seed.
stage.note: No priced round beyond seed has been publicly reported; Caplight (an aggregator) lists all known investors against a Seed round tag and shows no lead or date. Company itself (via SiliconANGLE) only discloses a cumulative funding figure, not round structure.

total_funding_usd.basis: Company-confirmed figure quoted directly to SiliconANGLE, matched by Caplight's aggregator total
total_funding_usd.quote: The startup, which has raised $8.6 million in funding so far, said its platform is already being used by customers such as the multinational car rental firm Sixt SE...

last_round.quote: TOTAL FUNDING RAISED $8.6M ... Tensorlake investors: Plug and Play Tech Center — Seed, Hawk Hill Ventures — Seed, Artisanal Ventures — Seed, Materialized View Capital — Seed.

note: Founded 2023 (per Caplight) by Diptanu Gon Choudhury, ex-Meta engineer; the company began as an open-source real-time/unstructured-data framework called Indexify (launched on HN May 2024), rebranded product focus to document parsing (Tensorlake Document AI) and then, by 2026, to a serverless agentic-workflow platform including Firecracker microVM sandboxes (the subject of this card). $8.6M total funding is the only figure the company/press disclose; no individual round amount, date, or lead investor is publicly confirmed. HQ San Francisco, ~15 employees per Caplight. No accelerator/incubator program found (Plug and Play appears only as a seed investor, not confirmed as an accelerator batch).
